comparison.method: Resize the phone viewport and retail Bink samples to 160x90 grayscale, sample the retail source at 10 fps, and choose the maximum normalized Pearson correlation.
comparison.interpretation: The live native Vulkan output advances through the original Franchise_Ident video at about 4.2% of its source rate. It continues showing intro-video frames rather than reaching the startup menu during this sample.

limits: Source positions are nearest matches from a 10-fps sample and are quantized to 0.1 seconds.
This is a live playback-rate observation, not a before/after speedup result; the installed app predates the R8 native-plane and row-copy optimizations.
The sample does not establish whether the intro loop requires input or identify the guest/runtime cause of the slow rate.
No language-selector or later gameplay frame was captured.
